job.title: Digital Forensics Analyst
job.description: Investigates cybercrimes and security incidents by recovering and analyzing digital evidence from devices, networks, and cloud systems.
job.note: Certified in EnCase or FTK forensic toolkits preferred.

job.title: Spatial Data Engineer
job.description: Builds and maintains geospatial data pipelines and mapping systems. Processes satellite imagery, GPS data, and GIS layers for urban planning and logistics applications.
job.note: Experience with PostGIS, QGIS, or ArcGIS required.

job.title: Bioinformatics Developer
job.description: Develops software tools and pipelines for processing and analyzing genomic and proteomic data. Works at the intersection of biology, statistics, and software engineering.
job.note: Familiarity with Python, R, and genomic file formats such as VCF and FASTQ expected.

job.title: Quantum Computing Researcher
job.description: Explores quantum algorithms and circuit design to solve computational problems beyond the capability of classical computers. Collaborates with hardware and software teams.
job.note: Background in quantum mechanics and linear algebra is mandatory.

job.title: Haptics Engineer
job.description: Designs tactile feedback systems for wearables, medical devices, and gaming controllers. Creates vibration patterns and force feedback mechanisms that enhance user experience.
job.note: Experience with actuator calibration and embedded systems required.

job.title: Neurotech Interface Developer
job.description: Builds software interfaces for brain-computer interaction devices. Processes EEG and neural signal data to translate brain activity into actionable digital commands.
job.note: Knowledge of signal processing and neuroscience fundamentals is essential.

job.title: Synthetic Media Auditor
job.description: Detects and classifies AI-generated deepfake content across video, audio, and image formats. Develops detection pipelines and reports findings to compliance teams.
job.note: Familiarity with GAN architecture and media forensics tools preferred.

job.title: Digital Twin Architect
job.description: Creates virtual replicas of physical systems such as factories, buildings, or supply chains using real-time IoT sensor data to simulate, monitor, and optimize operations.
job.note: Experience with IoT platforms, simulation engines, and 3D modeling tools required.

job.title: Algorithmic Bias Auditor
job.description: Evaluates machine learning models and automated decision systems for fairness, transparency, and compliance with ethical AI standards and regulatory frameworks.
job.note: Background in AI ethics, statistics, and fairness metrics such as demographic parity required.
